list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned (Exophase and PSNProfiles, cross-checked 18 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this atlas, in our own words, and names its sources.
sourcesNote: PowerPyx and GTABase for how-to steps and counts; Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list and hidden flags. Where no guide has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: What to do: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Where and how: there is no separate task — work the roadmap in order (story first, then side strands, then the long count-based grinds) and the platinum is the last thing you collect. Missable: no, it cannot be missed; it only waits for the other 54. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (official list, platinum grade).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Where and how: play the story from the start; the mission is the game's first story beat and unlocks the trophy when its final objective clears. Missable: no — story missions cannot be skipped past, and there is no way to finish the game without it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden story trophy).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: What to do: play through every mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Where and how: follow the story markers in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-end screen. Missable: no. Note for the road ahead: Chapter 1 also holds the first meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, so meditate there before the chapter ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden chapter trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (Chapter 1 meditation warning).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 2. Where and how: keep following the story markers after Chapter 1; both protagonists become playable here, which opens most of the open-world list. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden chapter trophy).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 3. Where and how: story markers in order; this chapter holds the Cartel Heist mission (Break the Bank). Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden chapter trophy); GTABase (chapter of the Cartel Heist).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: What to do: finish every mission of Chapter 4. Where and how: story markers in order; this chapter holds the VCIA Takedown mission (Hi-Jacked). Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden chapter trophy); GTABase (chapter of VCIA Takedown).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: What to do: complete the final story mission. Where and how: finish Chapters 1 to 4 and play the finale to its end; the gold pops when the credits roll. Missable: no. Before you start it, make a manual save: the finale is the point of no return for anything chapter-locked, and a save lets you go back for cleanup. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden gold story trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (save-before-finale advice).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Where and how: it appears as a story marker in the early chapters; play it through to the debrief and the trophy pops. Missable: no — it is a required story mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Where and how: a Chapter 3 story mission — follow the marker, complete each heist objective, and the trophy pops at the mission end. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy); GTABase (Chapter 3).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission Child's Play. Where and how: a story marker mission; play it through to the end and the trophy pops. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission Headliners. Where and how: a story marker mission; complete its objectives and the trophy pops at the debrief. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Where and how: a Chapter 4 story mission at the airport; complete the takedown objectives and the trophy pops. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy); GTABase (Chapter 4).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: What to do: finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Where and how: a story marker mission; play it through to the end and the trophy pops. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden mission trophy).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: What to do: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. Where and how: the checklist covers the story, side strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — in practice, finishing this atlas's other 53 trophies gets you most of the way there, and the game's own 100% screen shows exactly what is left. Do the count trophies (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, all shooting-range golds) before the final push, since they are the usual stragglers. Missable: no, but it is the longest grind in the list — both PowerPyx and GTABase rank it the hardest trophy. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (hardest trophy, 100% scope); Exophase, PSNProfiles (gold grade).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the tally. Where and how: stunts stack up naturally while driving and riding around Leonida; chase the tally deliberately on long highway runs and off-road jumps, switching vehicles to keep the stunt types varied. The game's stunt counter shows your running total, so check it between sessions. Missable: no — stunts can be done at any time after the opening. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (250-stunt count and tracking).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: What to do: try every type of activity in the game at least once — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest. Where and how: activities unlock as you explore; the in-game activity menu shows which types you have tried and which are still untouched, so work down that list rather than guessing. Missable: no, but check the menu early — one or two activity types only appear in specific places. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (activity types and menu tracking).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: What to do: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Where and how: visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and work through each challenge; gold needs accuracy and speed together, so learn one range's targets first, then repeat the pattern — the same weapon handling carries across all 42. Replay any challenge freely until gold lands. Missable: no — ranges stay open after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (42 challenges, gold requirement).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: What to do: win a Top Fun drone race at every race location. Where and how: find the Top Fun drone-race spots around Leonida and win at each one; a win only counts at the location where you race it, so the trophy needs a victory everywhere, not several wins in one place. Learn each course's corners on a practice run before racing for the win. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (every-location requirement).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: What to do: win 20 different races. Where and how: races are scattered across Leonida — street, off-road and water events all count as long as each race is a different one. Winning the same race twice does not add to the count, so keep moving to new start lines and tick them off the race list. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (20 different races).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: What to do: beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Where and how: take the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered and out-fish him — steady reeling beats frantic reeling, and a bigger catch wins the round. The challenge can be retried if you lose. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (fishing challenge against Cal).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: What to do: complete one arcade game. Where and how: find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start any game on it and play it to its end — finishing one game is enough, no high score needed. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (arcade completion).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: What to do: finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Where and how: Andy's missions appear as side markers across Leonida; play them in the order they unlock and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Missable: no — side strands stay available after the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden side-strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (stranger strands stay open).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: What to do: finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Where and how: Kenton's missions appear as side markers; play them in unlock order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden side-strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (stranger strands stay open).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: What to do: finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Where and how: Billy's missions appear as side markers; play them in unlock order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden side-strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (stranger strands stay open).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: What to do: complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Where and how: stranger markers appear all over the map — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are five of them, so keep taking stranger missions as they appear and the silver pops on the eighth completed strand. The game's stranger menu shows which strands are finished. Missable: no — strands stay available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (8 strands, stranger menu).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: What to do: finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Where and how: Randy's missions appear as side markers; play them in unlock order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden side-strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (stranger strands stay open).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: What to do: finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Where and how: Tyrone's missions appear as side markers; play them in unlock order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden side-strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (stranger strands stay open).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: What to do: meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, for both Jason and Lucia. Where and how: meditation spots are marked as you find them; sit and complete the meditation at each one, checking the count as you go so none is left half-done. Missable: YES — the only trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable. The first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter ends, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and do not rely on mission replay (there is none). Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (only possibly-missable trophy; Chapter 1 spot; 18 spots in 10 locations); Exophase, PSNProfiles (official list).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: What to do: hunt a unique animal for Bret. Where and how: Bret's strand points you to the animal's territory — track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the hunt to its end. The animal only appears under the conditions Bret describes, so read his briefing before you head out. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden strand trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (Bret's hunting strand).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 3 collectible card sets. Where and how: cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, side locations and mission areas — and each set needs every card in it, so collect by set rather than at random and use the collection menu to see which cards each set is still missing. Missable: no — cards stay collectible after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (3 sets, collection menu).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: What to do: use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Where and how: open WAiNK It at each new spot you visit — landmarks, viewpoints and named places all count, but the same location twice does not. The counter in the app shows your running total, so sweep region by region and let the count guide the route. Missable: no — locations stay open after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (100 locations, counter tracking).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 50 challenges. Where and how: challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities — the challenge menu lists them all with their progress, so work through the easiest ones first and let the harder ones (gold shooting-range medals, long stunt totals) finish in the background. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (50 challenges, challenge menu).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: What to do: with your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Where and how: build heat with your partner in the car — committing crimes in a busy area raises stars fast — then break line of sight, get out of the search zone and stay hidden until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement; losing the level alone does not count. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (partner + 4-star escape).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: What to do: with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Where and how: pick three shops close together, hit them one after another with your partner present, and keep the wanted level alive between robberies — do not let the stars clear or the chain breaks. A fast car parked outside each shop keeps the run moving. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (3 shops, keep the wanted level).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: What to do: discover 100 different vehicles. Where and how: every new vehicle you drive or ride adds to the count — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count, but the same model twice does not. Variety is the fastest route: try new vehicles whenever you see one instead of sticking to one car. The discovery counter shows your total. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (100 vehicles, discovery counter).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: What to do: take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Where and how: trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least five enemies close together, then chain the takedowns before the focus meter runs out — a crowded shootout or a gang hideout is the place to try it. If the focus ends early, the count resets, so pick a fight with enough targets. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (5 takedowns in one Combat Focus).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: What to do: leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — that is, take off in an aircraft without going through normal departure. Where and how: get to the airfield at VCIA, get into a plane and take off from the runway or taxiway without waiting for clearance; the trophy pops once you are airborne off-schedule. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (VCIA departure).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: What to do: deal with Rhino tanks — the description's joke is the hint that tanks are involved. Where and how: Rhinos show up at high wanted levels and at military spots; get into a confrontation with one (or take one for a drive) and the trophy pops once the tank encounter plays out. No confirmed step-by-step exists yet — PowerPyx and GTABase have not pinned the exact trigger down — so try the high-wanted-level route first and treat this as one to attempt, not one to plan around. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob a jewelry store without being detected. Where and how: plan the entry — go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; detection fails the attempt, not the trophy. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (undetected jewelry robbery).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: What to do: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Where and how: bank vaults are found in banks across Leonida — crack each vault, grab the take and get clear of the wanted level before the next. Each vault counts only if you escape, so plan the getaway before the robbery, not after. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (5 vaults, escape required).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob an armored truck and escape. Where and how: armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, break it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. The trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you open the truck. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (armored truck robbery and escape).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: What to do: explore every area of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Where and how: drive, ride and fly through each region — the map fills in as you visit, so sweep the state systematically (coast, city, swamps, keys and countryside) and check the map for dark patches. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery counts. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (full-map exploration).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: What to do: rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Where and how: each gang runs its own illegal operations — find one per gang, hit it and get clear. The trophy needs one operation from every gang, not several from the same one, so track which gangs you have done. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (one operation per gang).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: What to do: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Where and how: go to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it in with the view — the trophy is a story-moment trophy, and PowerPyx and GTABase list its exact trigger as not yet confirmed. Try it as a story beat first; if it does not pop at the bar, it will come from playing the story. Missable: no evidence it can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: What to do: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style — through the glass, in a car. Where and how: drive a car into a showroom, then smash out through the frontage; the trophy is a story-moment trophy whose exact trigger PowerPyx and GTABase list as not yet confirmed, so treat the showroom smash as the best-supported attempt. Missable: no evidence it can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: What to do: follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there. Where and how: find the Kolt & Associates alley, start a game and bowl through it; this is one of the activity types for Master of None, and the trophy pops from the bowling visit itself. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (bowling alley activity).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: What to do: reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat for Jason and Lucia as a duo. Where and how: the description gives no concrete step, and PowerPyx and GTABase list this trophy's trigger as not yet confirmed; it is a story-moment trophy, so play the story and it should pop at its moment rather than from any hunt. Missable: no evidence it can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: What to do: make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — GTABase reports a count of 500 profile-affecting actions. Where and how: play the game making choices (missions, side activities, crimes and lawful turns alike); each choice that moves the profile counts, and the trophy pops when the count is reached. It is a slow background tally, not a single decision. Missable: no. Sources: GTABase (500 Criminal Profile actions, single source); Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: What to do: succeed on a second try at something that failed the first time. Where and how: the description is the only hint, and PowerPyx and GTABase list the exact trigger as not yet confirmed — most likely a story or activity beat that only pops when a retry succeeds. Play normally, retry anything you fail, and do not force it. Missable: no evidence it can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What to do: witness something strange in Leonida — an odd random event. Where and how: the description is the only hint, and PowerPyx and GTABase list the exact trigger as not yet confirmed; it reads as a random-encounter trophy, so explore the state, follow odd sights and sounds, and it should pop when the event finds you. Missable: no evidence it can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (method unconfirmed at launch).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: What to do: knock someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a target with a melee weapon while driving past. Where and how: get a melee weapon, drive slowly past a target on foot and swing as you pass; the trophy pops on the hit. The exact conditions are still under investigation per PowerPyx and GTABase, so try it on a lone pedestrian away from heavy police presence. Missable: no. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles (hidden trophy); PowerPyx, GTABase (melee drive-by, conditions under investigation).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: What to do: earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Where and how: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash, and the tally builds toward $250,000. It is a long grind, so launder after every big score instead of letting bills pile up. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase ($250,000 laundering total).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: What to do: spend $100,000 across all shops. Where and how: buy weapons, clothes, vehicles, food and upgrades anywhere in Leonida — every shop purchase counts toward the same $100,000 total. Spending that supports other goals (garages, gear for the shooting range) counts double. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase ($100,000 spending total).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: What to do: purchase every garage property in Leonida. Where and how: garages are bought through the property menu when you have the cash — buy them as funds allow, since garages also store the vehicles you need for discovery and registration trophies. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (all garage properties).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: What to do: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Where and how: open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register vehicles you own or find — each new registration adds to the count of 10. Register as you discover new vehicles so the two tallies grow together. Missable: no. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase (10 registrations, Scooter Bros app).
trophies.name: On the Spot
